Tara: quick flag  noticed a discrepancy in yesterday's webinar KPI snapshot: total registrants vs dashboard count off by ~9%. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/marketing/webinar_kpis :eyes:

Ben: i'm seeing that too. the front-end event shows 2.1k regs, dashboard shows 1.9k. suspecting tracking pipeline filter on querystring.

Iris: running a small sql to compare raw_events -> processed signups for 2026-03-15
```
SELECT source, count(*) as raw, sum(processed) as proc
FROM tracking.events
WHERE event='webinar_register' AND day='2026-03-15'
GROUP BY 1;
```

Noah: FYI we rotated a tracking rule yesterday to drop empty utm_source values. might be overzealous and filtered some valid rows.

KPI-Bot: alert: signup_count_delta anomaly (score 5.1) for APAC cohort on 2026-03-15 11:02 UTC.

Tara: ok actionables: @Noah revert the filter and redeploy; @Iris can you surface the missing rows and drop them into /shared/marketing/tracking-errors/3105550000.csv; @Ben patch the KPI snapshot with a corrected count for the weekly review. target EOD please.

Iris: pulling rows now. early sample shows 184 events dropped where utm_source was blank but referrer present. uploading in 40m.

Noah: reverting filter now. rolling back in 1m. will monitor.

Ben: will update dashboard after Iris upload and post revised snapshot link.

Tara: thanks all. we'll call this out in Friday's KPI review as an attribution/data quality note. closing once snapshot updated. :lock:

KPI-Bot: summary auto: root cause - overzealous utm_source filter; impact - ~9% registrant undercount; remediation - revert filter, reprocess events, update KPI snapshot. archived.
